findings.summary: Verification command referenced a non-existent local helper.
findings.resolution: Replaced verification commands with cargo check from codex-rs and just test from codex-patched root.

findings.summary: visible_height() consistency was mentioned as a risk but not enforced.
findings.resolution: Added explicit plan, story, and acceptance criteria requiring visible_height() and render() to share the committed-reservation policy.

findings.summary: A one-row reservation could show only a blank separator instead of readable prompt text.
findings.resolution: Changed the regression and policy acceptance criteria to require identifiable committed-cell text in the live render.

findings.summary: Existing committed-only retained viewport snapshot was not explicitly guarded.
findings.resolution: Added acceptance criteria that the existing retained_transcript_main_view_tail snapshot remains unchanged.

findings.summary: New SANDBOX PATCH marker requirement was not explicit enough.
findings.resolution: Added story acceptance criteria requiring new or modified retained-allocation lines to carry a SANDBOX PATCH marker.
